NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Puanla uses your location to show popular places and posts near you. Your location is not stored on our servers.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access lets you take food photos for your posts.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo access lets you choose profile and post photos. Only the photos you pick are uploaded.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Permission lets you save share images (like your food map) to your photos.
NSContactsUsageDescription: Puanla uses your contacts to find friends already on Puanla and to invite people you ate with. Numbers are sent only for matching and stored on our servers as hashes; names never leave your device.
